title: A planned widening of what a comparison reads carries a check that an unrelated change does not trip it
goal: precheck warns of a committed item whose goal widens the set a detector compares (sections, windows, sources a verdict reads) when no check plants a change outside the widened set and asserts the verdict holds; in SP-vdrsfftl BG-vzsk2t5t's repro planted only the next section's edit, so the fallback that now reads the parent section flips on any sibling heading added on the page (BG-npdpbmw2)

run:
import sys, io, tempfile, contextlib, types, json, os
sys.path.insert(0, '_tools')
import bl_base as B, bl_land as L
FAIL = dict(run=['python3', '-c', 'import sys; sys.exit(1)'])
def run(goal):
    root = tempfile.mkdtemp()
    d = os.path.join(root, B.rel_dir())
    os.makedirs(d)
    it = dict(id='ST-aaaaaaaa', kind='story', status='draft', title='t', sprint='SP-bbbbbbbb', goal=goal, checks=[FAIL], touches=['_tools/factdiff.py'])
    sp = dict(id='SP-bbbbbbbb', kind='sprint', status='planned', title='s')
    for x in (it, sp):
        open(os.path.join(d, x['id'] + '.json'), 'w').write(json.dumps(x))
    buf = io.StringIO()
    with contextlib.redirect_stdout(buf):
        L.cmd_precheck(B.Backlog(root), types.SimpleNamespace(sprint='SP-bbbbbbbb'))
    return [l for l in buf.getvalue().splitlines() if l.startswith('warning') and 'widen' in l.lower()]
assert run('factdiff widens the sections it compares so the verdict also reads the parent section'), 'no widening warning'
assert not run('factdiff names the section in its report'), 'warning without a widening'
